notes: Unlike v.4, the closing clause has a participial predicate, so *do smite* is the participle's whole rendering and no copula is supplied; no interrogative morpheme is present, so the fronted *do* is the verb's own under rule 17.
The first clause writes no עַל, so nothing corresponds to v.4's unrepresented preposition; the ASV also writes no object after *spare*.
